about: Open sample datasets OpenDroneKit is tested and documented against. Files are always fetched from the original publisher, never mirrored by OpenDroneKit; every file is checked against the pinned sha256 in manifests/<name>.sha256 (the hashes of the copies the test suite was run on, see odk-testdata/INDEX.md). Licences are the publishers'.

datasets.name: odm_aukerman
datasets.title: OpenDroneMap Aukerman park survey (77 nadir images, GPS)

datasets.name: odm_sheffield_cross
datasets.title: Sheffield cross (172 oblique DJI images + 5 GCPs)

datasets.name: multispectral_buergewald_rededgep
datasets.title: Buergewald MicaSense RedEdge-P subset (24 captures x 6 bands)

datasets.name: multispectral_micasense_panels
datasets.title: MicaSense RedEdge-P and Altum calibration-panel captures

datasets.name: thermal_rjpeg_samples_thermal_parser
datasets.title: 65 radiometric thermal JPEGs from 16 camera models

datasets.name: thermal_pv_panel_detection_mavic3t
datasets.title: Thermal PV panel detection (353 Mavic 3T images, YOLO labels)
datasets.attribution: Thermal PV Panel Detection Dataset for UAV Inspection, Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.16420123

datasets.name: road_damage_rdd2022_subset
datasets.title: RDD2022 subset: 120 drone + 80 Indian road images with damage boxes
datasets.attribution: Arya et al. (2022), RDD2022, figshare, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.21431547
datasets.manual: The subset was cut out of the 13.3 GB release archive with HTTP range requests (random.seed(2022) samples of China_Drone/train and India/train). Download the archive from the source page, take the files named in the manifest, and run `verify` on the folder.

datasets.name: bridge_inspection_h20t_boga_cayi
datasets.title: Boga Cayi bridge, DJI H20T (RGB, R-JPEG, SDK-decoded C arrays, thermal ortho)
datasets.attribution: Boga Cayi bridge inspection dataset, Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22298893
datasets.manual: Frames 0100-0180 of B1_Wide and B1_Thermal were taken out of 4.5 GB and 2.2 GB archives with range requests; download B1_Wide.zip / B1_Thermal.zip from the source page and keep those frames.

datasets.name: thermal_nvs_praschl_zenodo
datasets.title: Building facade, DJI M30T (227 thermal R-JPEGs + 60 wide RGB)
datasets.attribution: Praschl et al., NVS dataset, Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17647950
datasets.manual: W_subset holds 60 of the wide RGB frames taken out of W.zip (1.3 GB) with range requests; download W.zip from the source page and keep the frames named in the manifest.

datasets.name: thermal_pv_thedpv_subset
datasets.title: THED-PV, FLIR Duo Pro R solar array session (58 radiometric TIFF + RGB pairs)
datasets.manual: One capture session (Raw Dataset/2024-12-21/12/20241221_120152) was read out of the 22.8 GB Raw Dataset.zip with range requests; download it from the source page and keep that folder.

datasets.name: university_of_guam_thermal
datasets.title: University of Guam radiometric thermal sets (DJI XT2)
datasets.attribution: University of Guam radiometric thermal datasets, Zenodo records 16741416, 16741344, 16741334, 16741435, 16741451
datasets.manual: Access-restricted on Zenodo: request access on the record pages (16741416, 16741344, 16741334, 16741435, 16741451) yourself. OpenDroneKit does not fetch files that sit behind an access request.

datasets.name: dji_thermal_sdk
datasets.title: DJI Thermal SDK (decodes DJI R-JPEG to degrees C)
datasets.manual: Proprietary: accept DJI's licence and download it yourself, then point ODK_DJI_TSDK_DIR at it. OpenDroneKit never downloads, ships or redistributes it.
